notes.title: SwayBods is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🎉 Launch announcement 🎉

SwayBods is released and now available on Steam! 
It's a fun puzzle game with a rhythm twist to it.  
Thank you for all the feedback, support and encouragement!
I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: SwayBods is releasing on August 22!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that SwayBods puzzle game will be releasing on Steam on August 22nd!


[previewyoutube=-NOsU8-ZgqM;full][/previewyoutube]

Tap the bubble monsters to guide them in a pendulum-like swaying movement along an arc. Your challenge? Time your taps perfectly to prevent the monsters from bumping into each other. Ready to test your timing and strategy skills? Dive in now and start swaying!

notes.title: Exciting News about SwayBods!
notes.content:
Hello everyone 👋

I am thrilled to announce the release of an updated demo for SwayBods! Dive into an immersive experience and get a sneak peek at what's in store.

I've added loads of new content to the demo based on your feedback. Discover enhanced gameplay mechanics that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Download the demo, and don't forget to share your thoughts!

Let the gaming begin! 

➡️ Don't forget to add SwayBods to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2766900/SwayBods/#game_area_purchase]Wishlist[/url] - Release coming soon!

Thank you for your support!

Cheers,
Seema

notes.title: SwayBods - Available for BETA play test
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
SwayBods is available for play test, Here are a few notes: 
[list]
[*]  There may be bugs, hopefully few. Please let me know if you find any. 
[*]  There is no NDA or anything like that, so you can talk about the game with anyone you like, or even make videos if you are so inclined 
[*]  The play test will run for limited time. 
[*]  In terms of feedback, it will be great to know about gameplay satisfaction, level difficulty, bugs and any other constructive inputs. The feedback can be provided in the [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/1202105053041659924/1218630651797045441]playtest[/url] channel of SwayBods discord server. Please place your message for playtest in SwayBods discord server for me to share a key. 
[/list]

Thank you so much for your interest in my game. Really appreciate it!
